units.title: Outdoors

continuous_text.title: Outdoors!
continuous_text.content:
Outdoors! Outdoors!
What can you see?
Outdoors! Outdoors!
What can you see?

There's a plant.
There's a lake.
There are some ducks
And a snake.
continuous_text.notes: Audio tracks 080 and 081. Includes substitution words: beach, tree, shells, bee.

continuous_text.title: Coconuts for Everyone!
continuous_text.content:
Frame 1
Narrator: A dog is on a beach. There's a tree. There are some coconuts.

Frame 2
Narrator: Here's a cat.
Dog: Look, Cat! Coconuts! Jump on me!

Frame 3
Cat: I can't get the coconuts!

Frame 4
Narrator: Here's a snake.
Snake: Is it a cat on a dog? Yes, it is!
Dog: Look, Snake! Coconuts! Jump on me!

Frame 5
Snake: I can't get the coconuts!

Frame 6
Narrator: Here's a frog.
Frog: Is it a snake on a cat on a dog? Yes, it is!
Dog: Look, Frog! Coconuts! Jump on me!

Frame 7
Dog: Jump, Frog, jump!

Frame 8
Frog: Hurray! Coconuts for everyone!
Animals: We're a great team!
continuous_text.speaker_structure: Narrator, Dog, Cat, Snake, Frog, Animals
continuous_text.notes: Lesson 4 Story across pages 50 and 51. Demonstrates teamwork and cooperation.

continuous_text.title: Greetings from The Bahamas
continuous_text.content:
Dear Zach,
This is a beach in The Bahamas. Can you see the sand? It's pink! There are some shells on the beach. There are some trees, too.
Look at the ocean! It's blue. There are some fish in the ocean. This fish is a Clown fish. It's orange and white.
I can play baseball on the beach. I can swim in the ocean, too.
From,
Alvin
continuous_text.notes: Lesson 5 Reading passage formatted as a travel postcard.
